scenario: archive.configure accepts an endpoint spelling the scheme's default port ('http://host:80', 'https://<ref>.supabase.co:443/storage/v1/s3'); both signers sign the Host as the endpoint's whole authority ('host:80') while libcurl sends 'Host: host' (it drops a default port), so the store answers 403 SignatureDoesNotMatch to every request and every export and every tick's chunk fails after the read. Same signed-host-vs-sent-host mechanism as the userinfo endpoint the round-2 head refuses; an endpoint the signers cannot use that configure still takes.
